source_or_search_failures.note: One county emergency management directory could not be accessed; alternate local and official sources remained accessible and no new qualifying cancellation was otherwise corroborated.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: All 12 bounded targeted searches returned results; 7 of 8 direct-source checks accessible. One county emergency directory could not be opened, making run DEGRADED by policy but not materially impairing current recall coverage. No source-verified newly qualifying disruption within the interval. Search-index delays and scope mean this is not proof of national absence.
coverage_notes.excluded_content: Donation drives, resource directories, recipes, opinion, routine promotions/closures/distributions, inflation, older or previously audited events, uncorroborated outage anecdotes.
coverage_notes.notification_assessment: No new qualifying signal and only nonmaterial single-source access failure; suppress user notification.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, production collection alteration, schedule change, or automation disabling.
